comment_regular: Verified restore path rebuilds the saved generated NiTriShape via BSTempEffectGeometryDecal_BuildGeneratedGeometry; it does not dispatch Initialize (+0x4C) or set base.initializeCallbackDone. A successfully restored effect can therefore own generated geometry while the callback guard remains false. This refines the field's meaning: it records Initialize callback completion, not general output existence.
